title: The Roof — EN/ES/FR (Pete McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 102bpm walking bass brushed drums English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Pete was up before the birds
Hammer in his hand, didn't need the words
Twenty years of rooftops, rain or shine
Oldest son, he held the family line

[Verse 2 — Español]
Tejas y madera, calor en su espalda [Tiles and timber, heat on his back]
No necesitaba planos, él sabía la trampa [He didn't need a plan, he knew the knack]
Cada casa que tocó sigue en pie y firme hoy [Every house he touched still stands firm today]
Ese es el tipo de hombre que Pete es para mí [That's the kind of man that Pete is to me]

[Chorus — English]
From the roof he could see everything
The hills, the river, where the sea begins
And maybe that's the moment, maybe that's the call
When you've been that high, you don't stop at all

[Bridge — Français]
Du toit il voyait tout ce qui comptait [From the roof he saw everything that mattered]
Les collines, la rivière, la mer au bout [The hills, the river, the sea at the end]
C'est peut-être ce moment, c'est peut-être l'appel [Maybe that's the moment, maybe that's the call]
Quand tu as été si haut, tu ne t'arrêtes pas [When you've been that high, you don't stop]

[Verse 3 — English]
Hung up the tool belt, walked toward the tide
Now he's on the water, boats and morning air
The roof is still there

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The roof is still there
El techo sigue allí [The roof is still there]
Le toit est toujours là [The roof is still there]
That's my boy
